definition: to do with chemistry and its substances
description: An old-fashioned chemistry lab with tall windows and a brass chandelier. A black and white border collie in a white lab coat stands up at a wooden bench and pours a clear liquid from a glass jug into a flask held in a metal stand, and the liquid turns bright purple and starts to bubble. A young woman in a lab coat and dark red jumper laughs beside it and then holds the glowing flask while the dog watches. A stoneware bottle, a rack of test tubes and a small brown bottle stand around them.

taps.phrase: to stand next to the dog
